items.title_zh: 最高折扣 50%：消息称微软推进 AI 替你“干活”，Copilot 同步变身超级应用
items.title_en: Microsoft Reportedly Offers Up to 50% Copilot Discounts, Preps 'Super AI App'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 23 日消息，科技媒体 The Information 昨日（9 月 22 日）发布博文，报道称 微软正准备以更激进的价格策略推动企业客户采用 Copilot，并推出“超级 AI 应用”。 在折扣方面，消息称微软已告知销售团队，将为企业客户的 Copilot AI 订阅提供更高力度的折扣，幅度约为 30% 至 50%。 IT之家援引博文介绍，相关优惠预计最快于 10 月实施，采购 1,000 个及以上席位的企业可获得约 30% 折扣； 采购规模达到 10,000 个及以上席位的客户，折扣最高可能达到 50%。 在产品方面，微软计划升级 Copilot 产品形态，推出 Copilot 超级 AI 应用， 整合 AI 编程工具，以及类似 OpenClaw 风格的智能体技能。 在定位方面，这款超级 AI 应用不仅能满足 Word、Excel、PowerPoint、Teams 等办公软件中的问答、总结和内容生成助手，还会进一步延伸成为自动化平台， 能够调用工具、执行多步骤任务、辅助软件开发等，让 AI 参与到企业现有端到端工作流中。
items.summary_en: The Information reports Microsoft is preparing steeper discounts on enterprise Copilot subscriptions — roughly 30% for 1,000+ seats and up to 50% for 10,000+ seats, possibly starting in October — while also building a "super AI app" bundling AI coding tools and agent-style skills. The app would extend Copilot from an assistant inside Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams into an automation platform that calls tools and runs multi-step tasks.
items.why_zh: 大力度折扣叠加超级应用，显示微软正以价格与产品双线加速企业级 AI 落地，争夺智能体办公入口。
items.why_en: Deep discounts plus a super-app push show Microsoft is racing to lock in enterprise AI adoption and own the agentic workplace.

items.title_zh: 马斯克惊叹中国 AI 大模型“单位算力产出性能几乎是全球顶尖水平”，预计两到三年内就能靠光刻技术与芯片制造补齐算力缺口
items.title_en: Musk: Chinese LLMs Near Global Top in Performance per Unit of Compute, Compute Gap Closable in 2-3 Years
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 23 日消息，特斯拉 CEO 埃隆 · 马斯克今日接受了央视财经专访。 当谈及 AI，他表示中国的 AI 大模型整体而言非常出色，单位算力产出的性能几乎全球顶尖。 他认为，中国解决算力问题的速度会比大多数人预想更快。粗略估计，大概两到三年内，中国就能依靠光刻技术与芯片制造补齐算力缺口。 图源：Pexels 谈及 AI 时代教育，马斯克建议广泛学习，兼顾人文艺术、科学与工程，夯实通识基础。 他表示，想要向机器人下达指令，就要学会组织问题；知识面越广，越擅长提问，这正是给 AI 写提示词。 马斯克此前曾表示，预计到 2027 年底，人工智能将独立完成所有数字领域工作，彻底替代人工直接操作的各类数字化岗位。 在短期技术突破上，他预判未来 12 至 18 个月内，AI 将在工程及各类数字领域实现能力跨越式提升。 其中，AI 编程能力最快明年达到“Stockfish 级”水准（IT之家注：Stockfish 是一款开源国际象棋引擎。届时人类开发者将丧失与 AI 在软件开发领域的竞争优势）。 谈及机器人，马斯克展望称，每个人都能拥有专属机器人，可照料年迈父母、看护孩童，还能担任孩子的一对一私教，承担各类工作。 他预测，十年内至少有 10 亿台人形机器人；未来 15 年或许达到 100 亿台；未来 20 年可能达到 1000 亿台。 马斯克还预测，未来会诞生大量企业，一个人可操…
items.summary_en: In an interview with CCTV Finance, Elon Musk said Chinese large models are very impressive, with performance per unit of compute near the global top, and predicted China could close its compute gap in roughly two to three years via lithography and chip manufacturing. He also urged broad, cross-disciplinary learning for the AI era and repeated forecasts of rapid AI capability gains and mass humanoid robot adoption.
items.why_zh: 来自头部科技人物的公开评价，关乎中美算力差距的走向以及 AI 对就业与教育的长期冲击。
items.why_en: A prominent tech leader's assessment bears on the China-US compute race and AI's long-term impact on jobs and education.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Sol 与 Luna，以低价冲击竞品
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna to Undercut Rivals on Price
items.summary_zh: 据 Startup Fortune 报道，OpenAI 发布了两款新模型 GPT-6 Sol 与 GPT-6 Luna，主打更低价格以压制竞争对手。报道未披露更多技术细节、具体定价数值或可用范围。此举延续了 OpenAI 以价格策略争夺模型市场份额的思路。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna to Undercut Rivals on Price Startup Fortune
items.why_zh: 头部厂商继续把定价当作竞争武器，可能进一步压低整个大模型市场的价格与利润空间。
items.why_en: Price-led launches from a market leader could further compress pricing and margins across the model market.

items.title_zh: 深蓝汽车官宣合作豆包大模型
items.title_en: Deepal Announces Partnership with Doubao Large Model
items.summary_zh: 深蓝汽车官宣合作豆包大模型 车家号
items.summary_en: Chinese automaker Deepal has announced a partnership with the Doubao large model, bringing LLM capabilities into its products. Public information so far is limited to the announcement, with no further details on scope or implementation.
items.why_zh: 车企接入国产大模型成为趋势，反映大模型正加速向智能座舱等终端场景渗透。
items.why_en: Automakers adopting domestic LLMs signals the accelerating push of large models into cockpit and in-vehicle scenarios.

items.title_zh: 更强更小：阿里安全27B模型登顶CyberGym，超越GPT-5.5-Cyber、Mythos等万亿参数模型
items.title_en: Alibaba Security's 27B Model Tops CyberGym, Beating Trillion-Parameter Rivals
items.summary_zh: 更强更小：阿里安全27B模型登顶CyberGym，超越GPT-5.5-Cyber、Mythos等万亿参数模型 hub.baai.ac.cn
items.summary_en: Alibaba Security's 27B-parameter model has taken the top spot on the CyberGym benchmark, outperforming trillion-parameter models including GPT-5.5-Cyber and Mythos, according to a report. The result highlights a smaller model achieving stronger cybersecurity performance.
items.why_zh: 小参数模型在安全评测上超越超大模型，说明领域专精与训练方法可能比单纯堆参数更关键。
items.why_en: A smaller model beating far larger ones suggests domain specialization and training methods can matter more than raw scale.

items.title_zh: 深蓝汽车官宣合作豆包大模型，全新深蓝S07首发搭载
items.title_en: Deepal Partners with Doubao LLM, Debuting on the New Deepal S07
items.summary_zh: 深蓝汽车官宣合作豆包大模型，全新深蓝S07首发搭载 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: Deepal has announced a partnership with the Doubao large model, with the new Deepal S07 set to be the first model to feature it. Public details so far are limited to the announcement and the debut vehicle.
items.why_zh: 大模型上车开始落到具体量产车型，是智能座舱竞争升级的又一实例。
items.why_en: An LLM reaching a specific production car marks another step in the intensifying smart-cockpit race.

items.title_zh: Ladders of Thought：用自演化课程逐步简化推理链，提升中小模型推理能力
items.title_en: Ladders of Thought: A Self-Evolving Curriculum of Progressively Simplified Reasoning Traces
items.summary_zh: 一篇新 arXiv 论文提出 Ladders-of-Thought（LoT）框架，用于改善大语言模型的推理能力。研究指出，LLM 在扩展到数千亿参数时推理表现出色，但中小规模模型即便经过知识蒸馏，推理仍然脆弱。LoT 会自动生成语义一致但更简单的推理问题变体，用基于步骤的度量将其划分为不同难度层级，并采用自演化的 bandit 调度器来安排训练课程，从而借助逐步简化的推理轨迹提升模型推理表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.25643v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at reasoning when scaled to hundreds of billions of parameters, but small- and mid-scale models remain brittle reasoners even with knowledge distillation (KD). We present Ladders-of-Thought (LoT), a framework that improves reasoning by combining progressive question rewrites with a self-evolving curriculum. LoT automatically generates semantically faithful but easier variants of reasoning problems, organizes them into difficulty buckets using step-based measures, and employs a self-evolving bandit scheduler to a…
items.why_zh: 面向中小规模模型的推理增强方法，有望降低获得高质量推理能力的算力门槛。
items.why_en: Reasoning gains for small and mid-scale models could lower the compute barrier to strong reasoning.

items.title_zh: FIRE：用失败信息做运行时工程，提升语言模型智能体可靠性
items.title_en: FIRE: Failure-Informed Runtime Engineering for Reliable Language-Model Agents
items.summary_zh: 一篇新 arXiv 论文提出 FIRE（Failure-Informed Runtime Engineering），针对语言模型智能体“能找到解法却难以稳定复现”的问题。研究考察运行时策略：在不修改模型权重、也不改动用户提示的前提下，由智能体运行框架在曾出现过失败的状态下施加有针对性的自然语言指令与动作拒绝。结果显示，在能力保持不变的情况下，智能体的交付可靠性获得明显提升；在完整的 87 项 Terminal-Bench 2.1 测试集上、每项任务尝试两次，该策略在三个 GPT-5.6 层级中均提升了重复成功率（pass^2）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.26048v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language-model agents often reach a working solution and then fail to consistently deliver it. We study runtime policies: targeted natural-language instructions and action denials applied by the agent harness at states that preceded observed failures, without changing model weights or the user prompt. With this, keeping capability constant, we observe a meaningful unlock in delivered reliability. Across the complete 87-task Terminal-Bench 2.1 suite, with two attempts per task, policies increase repeated success (pass^2) in all three GPT-5.6 tiers…
items.why_zh: 无需重训模型即可提升智能体的可靠交付，为智能体落地提供了一条低成本、可叠加的工程路径。
items.why_en: Boosting agent reliability without retraining offers a cheap, composable engineering path to deployment.

items.title_zh: 面向隐私感知多智能体 LLM 工作流的选择不变通信编译器
items.title_en: Selection-Invariant Communication Compilers for Privacy-Aware Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
items.summary_zh: 该论文指出，结构化多智能体工作流在交换中间消息时，即使最终输出是安全的，消息的内容与形式仍可能泄露私有状态。作者将这种风险命名为“选择通道泄露”：在授权机制已确定哪些内容可以发布之后，系统在多个语义等价表达中所做的、依赖私有状态的选择，会额外形成一条推理信道。为应对这一问题，论文提出“选择不变通信编译器”（SICC），它约束授权后的表示核，而不是规定固定模板。摘要称，任何确定性或独立公开的随机化策略都能满足其选择不变性要求。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.26076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structured multi-agent workflows exchange intermediate messages whose content and form can reveal private state even when the final output is safe. We identify selection-channel leakage: after authorization fixes what may be released, a private-state-aware choice among semantically valid realizations creates an additional inference channel. We introduce the selection-invariant communication compiler(SICC), which constrains this post-authorization representation kernel rather than prescribing templates. Any deterministic or independently public-ra…
items.why_zh: 它把多智能体隐私保护从“发布什么”推进到“如何在等价表达中做选择”，补上了此前被忽视的泄露通道。
items.why_en: It extends multi-agent privacy from what is released to how equivalent realizations are selected, closing a previously overlooked leakage channel.

items.title_zh: 基于 DWI 时序深度学习的乳腺癌新辅助化疗 pCR 早期预测
items.title_en: Early Prediction of Pathological Complete Response to Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Using Temporal Deep Learning on DWI
items.summary_zh: 研究聚焦乳腺癌新辅助化疗（NACT）中尽早识别不响应者的需求，因为及时调整治疗方案对患者至关重要。现有预测模型多依赖多参数 MRI、较晚的治疗时间点或大量临床数据，限制了实际适用性。该研究提出一个深度学习框架，仅使用基线和第一个 NACT 周期后的扩散加权 MRI（DW-MRI）即可预测病理完全缓解（pCR）。摘要显示该框架以裁剪后的影像作为输入，但原文在此处被截断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.26106v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Early identification of non-responders to neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) is crucial for timely treatment adaptation in breast cancer. However, many existing predictive models rely on multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), late treatment time points, or extensive clinical data, which limits their applicability. This study proposes a deep learning framework for early prediction of pathological complete response (pCR) using only diffusion-weighted MRI (DW-MRI) acquired at baseline and after the first NACT cycle. This framework feeds crop…
items.why_zh: 用更少的影像与更早的时间点实现 pCR 预测，有望让疗效评估提前、降低检查负担。
items.why_en: Predicting pCR with fewer scans and earlier time points could make treatment adaptation faster and reduce imaging burden.

items.title_zh: EADC：大语言模型高级与深层合规性评估
items.title_en: EADC: Evaluation of Advanced and Deep-level Compliance in Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型正被广泛用于各行业，但确保其符合复杂的法律与监管框架仍是一大挑战。论文指出，现有评估范式主要依赖静态基准，存在三大局限：一是所用合规规则本身不符合人工智能法律法规的要求；二是只能处理表面、显性的合规风险，无法发现隐含与隐蔽的合规风险；三是无法跟踪后续变化（原文在此处截断）。作者据此提出 EADC，用于评估大语言模型的高级与深层合规性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.26175v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used in various industries. However, ensuring their compliance with complex laws and regulatory frameworks remains a great challenge. Existing evaluation paradigms mainly rely on static benchmarks that suffer from three severe limitations: First, the compliance rules being used do not comply with the requirements of Artificial Intelligence (AI) laws and regulations; Second, they only handle apparent, explicit compliance risks, leaving implicit and covert compliance risks undetected; Third, they fail to track…
items.why_zh: 合规评估若只覆盖显性风险，监管要求与实际部署之间的落差将持续放大。
items.why_en: If compliance evaluation only covers explicit risks, the gap between regulation and real-world deployment keeps widening.

items.title_zh: 扰动来源决定一切：自适应调节中的外部、内部与控制生成噪声
items.title_en: The Source of Disturbance Matters: External, Internal, and Control-Generated Noise in Adaptive Regulation
items.summary_zh: 论文关注一个反直觉现象：自适应调节本身可能扰动它想要稳定的状态。作者在可复现的仿真中比较三类扰动——外部扰动、持续的内部生成扰动，以及控制器自身产生的扰动，并分别在“先调节”与“先扰动”的顺序下测试。结果显示，在测试参数范围内，持续的内部扰动带来最大的暴露量与调节负担。当控制器的正向更新立即产生扰动代价时，提高该代价会出现非单调响应（原文在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.26428v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Adaptive regulation can itself perturb the state it is intended to stabilize. In replicated simulations of an adaptive agent, we compare external disturbance, persistent internally generated disturbance, and control-generated disturbance under regulation-first and disturbance-first ordering. Persistent internal disturbance produces the largest exposure and regulatory burden within the tested parameter grid. When positive controller updates generate an immediate disturbance cost, increasing that cost produces a nonmonotonic response: effective dis…
items.why_zh: 区分扰动来源有助于理解某些控制策略为何会自伤，并为更稳健的自适应系统设计提供依据。
items.why_en: Distinguishing disturbance sources clarifies when control strategies harm themselves and informs more robust adaptive system design.

items.title_zh: JEV-as-a-Judge：有把握就接受，不确定就升级
items.title_en: JEV-as-a-Judge: Accept When Confident, Escalate When Unsure
items.summary_zh: LLM-as-a-judge 能在多种任务上实现自动评估，但在规模化应用中，推理成本与置信度可靠性成为关键问题。论文研究仅做决策的判定器（decision-only judge）能否充当经济的第一道筛选，并识别何时需要更强的评估。作者将 jev-as-a-judge 与 16 个生成式与奖励模型评委比较，并以盲法人工裁决为参照：在普通偏好与有证据支撑的事实性任务上，其结果与最强对比模型（一个最先进的 LLM 评委）相差不超过 3 个百分点，而费用仅为后者的 0.36%。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.26550v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge enables evaluation across diverse tasks, but inference cost and confidence reliability become critical at scale. We study whether a decision-only judge can provide an economical first pass and identify when stronger evaluation is needed. Comparing jev-as-a-judge with sixteen generative and reward-model judges, with blinded human adjudication, we find it within three percentage points of a state-of-the-art LLM judge, our strongest comparator, on ordinary preference and evidence-grounded factuality at 0.36% of the comparator's fee. L…
items.why_zh: 若能以极低成本接近顶尖评委的准确度，大规模评测的成本结构将被显著改写。
items.why_en: Approaching top-tier judge accuracy at a fraction of the cost could reshape the economics of evaluation at scale.

items.title_zh: 在策略蒸馏中，提示广度与 rollout 刷新的交互作用
items.title_en: Prompt Breadth and Rollout Refresh Interact in On-Policy Distillation
items.summary_zh: 论文研究在策略蒸馏（OPD）中究竟需要多少提示，以及答案如何取决于生成训练响应的学生策略。作者联合考察两个控制变量：提示广度与 rollout 刷新。在一个 3×3 的数学推理实验中，固定 14,080 条轨迹和 110 次优化器更新，只改变提示库与生成响应的策略快照数量。结果显示，使用十个快照时，仅八个提示即可达到 24.09% 的平均准确率，接近使用 14,080 个不同提示所取得的 24.51%（原文在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.25048v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: How many prompts does on-policy distillation (OPD) need, and how does the answer depend on the student policies that generate its training responses? We study these two controls jointly: prompt breadth and rollout refresh. A 3x3 mathematical-reasoning experiment fixes 14,080 trajectories and 110 optimizer updates while varying the prompt bank and the number of response-generating policy snapshots. With ten snapshots, eight prompts reach 24.09% average accuracy, close to 24.51% for 14,080 distinct prompts. With responses frozen at the initial po…
items.why_zh: 提示数量与策略快照之间的取舍，直接决定蒸馏训练的计算开销与效果上限。
items.why_en: The trade-off between prompt count and policy snapshots directly shapes the compute cost and ceiling of distillation training.

items.title_zh: 迈向可持续磁共振成像：整支扫描仪机队的长期高分辨率能耗记录
items.title_en: Towards Sustainable Magnetic Resonance Imaging: Insights from long-term, high-resolution energy recordings across an entire scanner fleet
items.summary_zh: 磁共振成像（MRI）是医疗领域能耗最高的诊断手段之一，但其能耗水平及影响因素仍缺乏充分认识。该研究旨在建立 MRI 能耗的全面基线：刻画整支扫描仪机队的能耗需求，考察临床实践中的设备利用与运行模式，并分析能耗与相关运行、采集特征之间的关系。摘要提到“平均而言，单台设备……”，但原文在此处被截断，未给出具体的能耗数值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.25150v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is among the most energy-intensive diagnostic modalities in healthcare, yet its energy consumption and the factors influencing it remain insufficiently understood. This study aims to establish a comprehensive baseline of MRI energy consumption by characterizing energy demand across a scanner fleet, examining scanner utilization and operating patterns in clinical practice. Concurrently, it investigates the relationships between energy consumption and relevant operational and acquisition features. On average, a si…
items.why_zh: 缺乏能耗基线，医院与厂商就难以针对 MRI 制定可信的节能与减排目标。
items.why_en: Without an energy baseline, hospitals and vendors cannot set credible efficiency and emissions targets for MRI.

items.title_zh: Neural Defend ARCAS 1B 基准测评：一个基础性多模态深度伪造检测模型
items.title_en: Benchmarking Neural Defend ARCAS 1B: A Foundational Multimodal Deepfake Detection Model
items.summary_zh: AI 生成图像的演进速度快于针对单一基准的检测器评估，因此单个分数无法完整反映模型的泛化能力。论文在不做基准专属参数更新的前提下，跨多个基准族评估 Neural Defend ARCAS 1B。作者保留原生聚合指标，并补充记录级度量、覆盖度核算与子群诊断；每个结果小节都会说明所用版本与评估人群、报告官方指标，并描述观察到的错误模式。最后通过一项综合分析（原文在此处截断）对结果进行汇总。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.25154v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI-generated imagery evolves faster than benchmark-specific detector evaluations, making a single score an incomplete account of generalization. This paper evaluates Neural Defend ARCAS 1B across benchmark families without benchmark-specific parameter updates. We retain native aggregation and supplement it with record-level measures, coverage accounting, and subgroup diagnostics. Each Results subsection identifies the release and evaluation population, reports the official metric, and describes observed error patterns. A combined analysis synth…
items.why_zh: 用跨基准、多层次的诊断替代单一分数，才能真正看清深度伪造检测器的泛化边界。
items.why_en: Replacing a single score with cross-benchmark, multi-level diagnostics is what actually reveals a deepfake detector's generalization limits.

items.title_zh: 「训练了却学不会」：面向担任前线部署工程师的 LLM 智能体的后训练交付基准
items.title_en: Trains but Doesn't Learn: A Post-Training Delivery Benchmark for LLM Agents as Forward-Deployed Engineers
items.summary_zh: 论文关注正在兴起的「后训练即服务」（PTaaS）：客户把数据和目标交给运营方，由前线部署工程师（FDE）在预算限制、人工审批关卡和可复现性要求下，交付一个已微调、已评估并已部署的模型。把 LLM 智能体放到 FDE 的位置上，会引出现有基准无法回答的问题——不是智能体能否把某个指标做上去，而是它是否值得信赖、能把交付做好。作者构建了一个受治理的交付平面，智能体需要驱动十个阶段，并由 oracle 对每个阶段进行评分。标题点出了核心发现：这类智能体可能「会训练，却学不会」。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.25237v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Post-training is becoming a service (PTaaS): a customer hands an operator data and a goal, and a forward-deployed engineer (FDE) returns a fine-tuned, evaluated, and deployed model under a budget, a human-approval gate, and reproducibility requirements. Seating an LLM agent in the FDE seat raises a question existing benchmarks cannot answer: not whether an agent can raise a metric, but whether it can be trusted to deliver. We answer it on a governed delivery plane, where an agent drives ten stages and an oracle scores each stage from platform-r…
items.why_zh: 它把 LLM 智能体的评价标准从「能否提升指标」转向「能否被信任完成交付」，为后训练即服务建立了可审计的评测基准。
items.why_en: It shifts evaluation of LLM agents from metric improvement to trustworthy delivery, establishing an auditable benchmark for post-training-as-a-service.

items.title_zh: VLAQuantBench：视觉-语言-动作模型训练后量化的闭环评测
items.title_en: VLAQuantBench: Closed-Loop Evaluation of Post-Training Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary_zh: 训练后量化（PTQ）能降低视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的内存占用，但精度选择必须考虑层范围、数值格式与校准方式之间的相互作用。作者提出 VLAQuantBench，一个包含 409 次运行、94,574 个仿真回合的受控评测：在 LIBERO 上评估四个模型，X-VLA 还额外在三个仿真基准族上测试。结果显示，在未校准的 W4A4 最近舍入量化下，把 π0.5 动作头子集从 126 层扩大到 167 层反而会降低成功率。这说明量化配置的细节会显著影响 VLA 策略的实际表现，必须通过闭环评测来判断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.25376v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Post-training quantization reduces the memory requirements of vision-language-action (VLA) models, but precision selection must account for the interaction between layer scope, numerical format, and calibration. We introduce \textbf{VLAQuantBench}, a controlled evaluation with 409 runs and 94,574 simulation episodes: four models on LIBERO, with X-VLA additionally evaluated on three simulation benchmark families. Under uncalibrated W4A4 round-to-nearest quantization, expanding a $\pi_{0.5}$ action-head subset from 126 to 167 layers raises succes…
items.why_zh: 它为 VLA 模型的量化部署提供了可复现的闭环评测标准，提醒精度选择不能只看内存收益。
items.why_en: It provides a reproducible closed-loop standard for quantizing VLA models, warning that precision choices cannot be judged by memory savings alone.

items.title_zh: 从专家到子专家：面向 MoE 大模型的细粒度参数高效微调
items.title_en: From Experts to Sub-experts: Fine-grained Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for MoE LLMs
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型规模快速扩张，稠密全参数适配越来越昂贵，推动了 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）等稀疏模块化架构的发展。这给参数高效微调（PEFT）提出了一个关键问题：应以什么粒度选择和更新参数？LoRA 等现有方法作用于预定义的权重矩阵，而专家级稀疏调优方法则整体更新被选中的专家。作者观察到，被激活的专家在内部本身也是稀疏的，因此提出从「专家」进一步细化到「子专家」的细粒度微调方案，以在更小的参数预算下实现更精准的适配。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.25655v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) scale rapidly, dense full-parameter adaptation becomes increasingly expensive, motivating sparse and modular architectures such as Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. This shift raises a key question for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT): at what granularity should parameters be selected and updated? Existing PEFT methods such as LoRA operate on predefined weight matrices, while expert-level sparse tuning methods update entire selected experts. However, we observe that activated experts are internally sparse, w…
items.why_zh: 它把 MoE 微调的粒度从整个专家推进到子专家，为大规模稀疏模型的低成本适配提供了新思路。
items.why_en: It pushes MoE fine-tuning granularity from whole experts to sub-experts, offering a cheaper path to adapting large sparse models.

items.title_zh: 风险感知的在线保形状态探测
items.title_en: Risk-Aware Online Conformal State Probing
items.summary_zh: 以数据中心为宿主的 AI 自主智能体，必须从机器人或边缘设备获取状态信息，才能做出有依据的控制决策。在安全攸关的场景中，对状态不确定性的平均意义保证并不充分，因此作者研究一个序贯决策过程：在可以调用任意状态预测模型的前提下，决策者需要联合决定采取哪些动作、以及何时进行探测以获取更准确的状态。为此，论文提出在线保形状态探测（OCSP）方法，在动作决策与探测时机之间做风险感知的权衡。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.25889v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI-based autonomous agents, typically hosted at data centers, must acquire state information from robots or edge devices in order to issue informed control decisions. Managing uncertainty about the state is particularly consequential in safety-critical settings, in which average-case guarantees are insufficient. In this context, we study a sequential decision maker process that jointly decides which actions to take and when to probe given access to an arbitrary state prediction model. We propose online conformal state probing (OCSP), an action…
items.why_zh: 它把保形预测引入在线状态探测决策，为安全攸关的自主系统提供了风险感知的不确定性管理手段。
items.why_en: It brings conformal prediction into online probing decisions, giving safety-critical autonomous systems a risk-aware way to manage state uncertainty.

items.title_zh: 出行领域大语言模型的安全与隐私问题
items.title_en: On the security and privacy of LLMs in Mobility
items.summary_zh: 生成式人工智能的进步正推动出行行业发生范式转变。仅汽车一项，全球市场年规模约 2.9 万亿美元，相关技术的整合可能影响全球超过 15 亿辆汽车。随着大语言模型（LLM）在出行领域被越来越多地采用，网络安全、隐私与可靠性方面的担忧也随之浮现。本文对当前的应用进行综述，并对这些挑战作出评估，同时讨论了欧盟相关监管背景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.26295v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The mobility sector is undergoing a paradigm shift driven by advances in Generative Artificial Intelligence. With a global market valued at approximately 2.9 trillion dollars annually, considering only cars, the integration of these technologies has the potential to impact more than 1.5 billion vehicles worldwide. As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted in mobility, concerns about cybersecurity, privacy, and reliability emerge. Accordingly, this paper surveys current applications and assesses these challenges. Since the Europea…
items.why_zh: 它系统梳理了 LLM 进入出行领域后的安全与隐私风险，为这一万亿级市场的合规落地提供参考。
items.why_en: It systematically maps the security and privacy risks of LLMs in mobility, informing compliance for a trillion-dollar market.

items.title_zh: DeepFEAv2：突破结构化网格的瞬态有限元分析深度学习
items.title_en: DeepFEAv2: Deep Learning for Transient Finite Element Analysis Beyond Structured Meshes
items.summary_zh: 有限元分析（FEA）被广泛用于瞬态力学仿真，但其高昂的计算成本限制了实时与高分辨率应用。深度学习代理模型可以降低这一成本，然而许多现有方法仅限于稳态预测，或者无法在时间维度上同时预测基于节点和基于单元的输出（NEO）。此前的领先框架 DeepFEA 已针对这些问题做出改进，但仍局限于结构化有限元网格。为突破这一限制，本研究提出了 DeepFEAv2，把深度学习瞬态有限元分析扩展到非结构化网格场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.26426v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Finite Element Analysis (FEA) is widely used for transient mechanical simulations, but its high computational cost limits real-time and high-resolution applications. Deep learning surrogate models can reduce this cost; however, many existing approaches are restricted to steady-state prediction or cannot jointly predict Node- and Element-based Outputs (NEO) over time. The state-of-the-art DeepFEA framework has addressed these issues but remains limited to structured finite element (FE) meshes. To overcome this limitation, this study proposes Dee…
items.why_zh: 它把深度学习代理模型扩展到非结构化网格的瞬态有限元分析，有望推动工程仿真走向实时与高分辨率。
items.why_en: It extends deep-learning surrogates to transient FEA on unstructured meshes, potentially enabling real-time, high-resolution engineering simulation.

items.title_zh: 有能力却节俭：提取并刻画前沿模型隐藏的思维链
items.title_en: Capable yet Parsimonious: Extracting and Characterizing Hidden Chain-of-Thought in Frontier Models
items.summary_zh: 前沿语言模型能力的快速提升，常被归因于推理能力的增强，但由于闭源系统的原始思维链（CoT）轨迹被隐藏，这一点难以验证。作者通过标准 API 功能注册一个简单的自定义工具，诱导前沿模型把中间推理过程外化出来。由于这些轨迹可能只是事后合理化而非真实推理，作者先在开源模型上将其与原生 CoT 进行对照评估，再扩展到包括 GPT-6 Astra 在内的闭源前沿模型。研究发现这些外化的推理轨迹呈现出「有能力却节俭」的特征。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.26637v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rapid capability gains of frontier language models are widely attributed to improved reasoning abilities, yet this cannot be verified as raw CoT traces in closed-source systems are hidden. By registering a simple custom tool through a standard API feature, we induce frontier models to externalize intermediate reasoning. Because these traces may reflect post-hoc rationalization rather than genuine reasoning, we first evaluate against native CoT on open-source models and extend to closed-source frontier models including GPT-6 Astra. We find t…
items.why_zh: 它提供了一种探查闭源前沿模型隐藏推理过程的方法，并提示外化的思维链未必等同于真实推理。
items.why_en: It offers a way to probe the hidden reasoning of closed frontier models, while cautioning that externalized traces may not equal genuine reasoning.

items.title_zh: 基于 LLM 的代码漏洞修复中的指标失效：实证研究与变更感知筛选
items.title_en: Metrics Failure in LLM-Based Code Vulnerability Repair: An Empirical Study and a Change-Aware Screen
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于自动修复 C/C++ 安全漏洞，而编译率——即生成的补丁能否通过编译——常被作为衡量进展的代理指标。作者认为，对于单函数漏洞修复而言，编译率在科学上并不可靠，并用五组受控实验加以论证：实验覆盖 Big-Vul 中的 203 个易受攻击函数、三个开源代码 LLM（参数量从 350M 到 6.7B）以及三种提示策略。结果显示编译率几乎不随干预变化，难以区分修复质量。据此，作者提出了一种变更感知（change-aware）的筛选方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.26749v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to the automated repair of C/C++ security vulnerabilities, and compile rate is a commonly reported proxy for progress: whether the generated patch compiles. We argue that compile rate is a scientifically unreliable metric for single-function vulnerability repair, and we support this with five controlled experiments over 203 vulnerable functions from Big-Vul, three open-source code LLMs (350M to 6.7B parameters), and three prompting strategies. Compile rate (i) barely responds to an intervent…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了漏洞修复研究中被广泛使用的编译率指标失效，并给出更可靠的变更感知评估筛选方案。
items.why_en: It exposes the failure of the widely used compile-rate metric in vulnerability repair and offers a more reliable change-aware screening alternative.

items.title_zh: Glucose-ML：面向稳健 AI 解决方案的纵向糖尿病数据集集合
items.title_en: Glucose-ML: A collection of longitudinal diabetes datasets for development of robust AI solutions
items.summary_zh: AI 算法已成为糖尿病数字健康管理中的关键技术，但大规模高质量数据集的获取困难，正在成为开发稳健 AI 方案的障碍。为加速透明、可复现且稳健的 AI 方案研发，作者发布 Glucose-ML——一个汇集 10 个公开糖尿病数据集的集合，这些数据集均在近 7 年（2018—2025）内发布。该集合包含超过 30 万天的连续血糖监测（CGM）数据，为糖尿病 AI 研究提供统一的数据基础。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2507.14077v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms are a critical part of state-of-the-art digital health technology for diabetes management. Yet, access to large high-quality datasets is creating barriers that impede development of robust AI solutions. To accelerate development of transparent, reproducible, and robust AI solutions, we present Glucose-ML, a collection of 10 publicly available diabetes datasets, released within the last 7 years (i.e., 2018 - 2025). The Glucose-ML collection comprises over 300,000 days of continuous glucose monitor (CGM)…
items.why_zh: 它把分散的公开糖尿病数据整合为统一资源，直接降低稳健 AI 医疗方案的研发门槛。
items.why_en: It consolidates scattered public diabetes data into a single resource, lowering barriers to building robust AI healthcare solutions.

items.title_zh: EndoCogniAgent：用于内镜诊断的自一致性闭环智能体推理
items.title_en: EndoCogniAgent: Closed-Loop Agentic Reasoning with Self-Consistency Validation for Endoscopic Diagnosis
items.summary_zh: 内镜诊断是一个迭代过程：临床医生需先获取、比对并核实局部视觉证据，才能得出结论。现有 AI 系统难以充分支持这一流程，因为细粒度证据获取与多步推理之间耦合较弱，使图像发现与其文本解释难以相互印证，进而产生两类失效模式——幻觉证据与未被纠正的错误累积，损害诊断可靠性。为此作者提出 EndoCogniAgent，以闭环智能体推理结合自一致性验证来应对上述问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2508.07292v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Endoscopic diagnosis is an iterative process in which clinicians acquire, compare, and verify local visual evidence before reaching a conclusion. Current AI systems do not adequately support this process because fine-grained evidence acquisition and multi-step reasoning remain weakly coupled, complicating reconciliation of image-derived findings with their textual interpretations. This gives rise to two failure modes, hallucinated evidence and uncorrected error accumulation, that undermine diagnostic reliability. We propose EndoCogniAgent, a…
items.why_zh: 它针对医疗诊断 AI 中最致命的幻觉与错误累积问题，提出可验证的闭环推理范式。
items.why_en: It targets the critical failure modes of hallucinated evidence and error accumulation with a verifiable closed-loop reasoning paradigm for medical diagnosis.

items.title_zh: Benchmark Radar：AI 基准测试与评估的活数据库与搜索引擎
items.title_en: Benchmark Radar: A Living Database and Search Engine for AI Benchmarks and Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）及其他 AI 系统的基准研究者与开发者，需要找到相关评测、定位其基准数据集与代码，并理解所报告分数背后的实验设置。为此作者提出 Benchmark Radar，一个用于 AI 基准检索与发现的“活”数据库与搜索引擎，覆盖 LLM 评测、智能体与工具使用、编码、推理、安全以及领域专用评测。该系统把每日发现的基准论文、代码仓库、数据集与发布信息结合起来。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11115v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Benchmark researchers and developers of large language models (LLMs) and other AI systems need to find relevant evaluations, locate their benchmark datasets and code, and understand the settings behind reported scores. We present Benchmark Radar, a living database and search engine for retrieval and discovery of AI benchmarks, covering LLM evaluation, agentic and tool-use benchmarks, coding, reasoning, safety, and domain-specific evaluations. The system combines daily discovery of benchmark papers, repositories, datasets, and releases with a…
items.why_zh: 在基准爆炸式增长的时代，它提供了持续更新、可检索的评测元信息基础设施。
items.why_en: Amid an explosion of benchmarks, it provides continuously updated, searchable infrastructure for evaluation metadata.

items.title_zh: 面向 AI × DB 工作负载的有效编排
items.title_en: Towards Effective Orchestration of AI x DB Workloads
items.summary_zh: AI 驱动的分析在数据驱动的决策中日益关键。但将关系算子与 AI 算子放在彼此分离的运行时中执行，会使数据库优化器和运行时无法协调算子顺序、模型放置、批处理与状态复用。把 AI 算子集成进数据库引擎可实现这类协调，却也带来新挑战：联合优化查询处理与模型执行、资源竞争下的调度，以及复用关系中间结果与 AI 产物。该论文对 AIxDB 工作负载进行了形式化研究。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.03772v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: AI-driven analytics are increasingly crucial to data-centric decision-making. Executing relational and AI operators in separate runtimes prevents the database optimizer and runtime from coordinating operator ordering, model placement, batching, and state reuse. Integrating AI operators into database engines enables such coordination but raises challenges in jointly optimizing query processing and model execution, scheduling under resource contention, and reusing relational intermediates and AI artifacts. This paper formalizes AIxDB work…
items.why_zh: 它指向数据库与 AI 融合的核心工程难题，有望显著提升 AI 分析的执行效率。
items.why_en: It addresses the core engineering challenge of unifying databases and AI, with potential for major efficiency gains in AI-driven analytics.

items.title_zh: 看见想象之物：fMRI 视觉想象解码中的潜在功能对齐
items.title_en: Seeing the imagined: latent functional alignment in visual imagery decoding from fMRI data
items.summary_zh: 近年来，Natural Scenes Dataset（NSD）等大规模数据集与强大的扩散生成模型，推动了基于 fMRI 的视觉脑解码进展。但现有流程主要针对“感知”进行优化，其在“心理想象”条件下的表现仍不清楚。本文研究如何把先进的感知解码器 DynaDiff 适配到 NSD-Imagery 基准上，从大脑信号重建想象内容，并提出潜在功能对齐（LFA）方法来完成映射。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.15374v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Recent progress in visual brain decoding from fMRI has been enabled by large-scale datasets such as the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) and powerful diffusion-based generative models. While current pipelines are primarily optimized for perception, their performance under mental-imagery remains less well understood. In this work, we study how a state-of-the-art (SOTA) perception decoder (DynaDiff) can be adapted to reconstruct imagined content from the NSD-Imagery benchmark. We propose a latent functional alignment (LFA) approach that maps…
items.why_zh: 它把脑解码从“看到什么”推进到“想象什么”，拓展了神经解码的能力边界。
items.why_en: It extends brain decoding from perception to mental imagery, broadening the scope of neural decoding.

items.title_zh: 多智能体推理中的旁观者效应：量化协作交互中的认知懈怠
items.title_en: The Bystander Effect in Multi-Agent Reasoning: Quantifying Cognitive Loafing in Collaborative Interactions
items.summary_zh: 多智能体系统（MAS）通常假设协作必然提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，本文对此提出质疑：研究表明，模拟的社会压力会触发算法层面的“旁观者效应”，导致严重的认知懈怠。作者在 GAIA、SWE-bench、Multi-Challenge 三种数据集情境下，用 3 个先进模型评估了 22,500 条确定性轨迹，并将内部推理轨迹与外部输出进行语义审计。研究还形式化了“交互深度上限”（D_L）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.10698v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) assume that collaborating inherently improves Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning. We challenge this by demonstrating that simulated social pressure triggers an algorithmic ``Bystander Effect,'' inducing severe cognitive loafing. By evaluating 22,500 deterministic trajectories across 3 dataset contexts (GAIA, SWE-bench, Multi-Challenge) with 3 state-of-the-art (SOTA) models, we semantically audit internal reasoning traces against external outputs. We formalize the \textit{Interaction Depth Limit} ($D_L$), the…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了多智能体协作可能反而降低推理质量，挑战了“协作必然增益”的默认假设。
items.why_en: It reveals that multi-agent collaboration can degrade reasoning quality, challenging the assumption that collaboration inherently helps.

items.title_zh: 拟正则神经学习的动力学
items.title_en: The Dynamics of Quasiregular Neural Learning
items.summary_zh: 许多学习问题都同时包含一个主导性规律和一些系统性例外。受语言习得中 U 型学习现象的启发，作者在规律解与例外解均已知的可控“拟正则”回归问题中研究二者的交互。结果显示，神经网络可以先部分习得例外，随后回退到主导规律，最终又重新恢复；这种“过度正则化”在例外稀少时明显更强，尽管这些例外在早期就被习得。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.26018v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many learning problems combine a dominant regularity with systematic exceptions. Motivated by U-shaped learning in language acquisition, we study this interaction in controlled quasiregular regression problems where regular and exceptional solutions are explicitly known. Neural networks can partially acquire exceptions, subsequently regress toward the dominant regularity, and finally recover. This overregularization becomes substantially stronger when exceptions are rare, despite their early acquisition, but does not emerge equally across all reg…
items.why_zh: 它为神经网络中的“U 型学习”与过度正则化现象提供了可控实验证据与动力学解释。
items.why_en: It provides controlled evidence and a dynamics account of U-shaped learning and overregularization in neural networks.

items.title_zh: MICRO：面向严重错误发现的多保真度主动搜索
items.title_en: MICRO: Multi-Fidelity Active Search for Severe Error Discovery
items.summary_zh: 人类反馈在成本与信息量上差异很大：强反馈能揭示严重错误，但代价高昂，因此更廉价的质量评分可帮助决定该标注哪些样本。作者提出 MICRO（多保真度影响聚类展开），一个主动搜索框架，在上述两类反馈之间分配共享预算，以最大化已确认的严重错误发现量。MICRO 以样本特征为条件联合建模评分与标注损失，并按预测的严重性概率影响对采集样本进行聚类筛选。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.26025v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Human feedback can vary in cost and informativeness. Strong feedback can reveal severe errors but is costly, so cheaper quality ratings can help decide which items to annotate. We propose MICRO (Multi-Fidelity Impact Clustered Rollout), an active search framework that allocates a shared budget to these feedback types to maximise confirmed severe error discoveries. MICRO jointly models ratings and annotation losses conditional on item features to steer acquisition. It clusters acquisitions by their predicted impact on severity probabilities to sel…
items.why_zh: 它把昂贵与廉价反馈结合进统一的预算分配策略，让严重错误的发现更高效。
items.why_en: It combines costly and cheap feedback under a unified budget policy to make severe-error discovery more efficient.

items.title_zh: OMatG-flash：面向可扩展材料发现的全原子流映射模型
items.title_en: OMatG-flash: An All-Atom Flow Map with Reinforce Adjoint Matching for Scalable Materials Discovery
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出 OMatG-flash，一个用于无机晶体结构预测（CSP）与从头生成（DNG）的全原子流映射模型，旨在突破当前流模型与扩散模型在生成候选材料时成本高昂的瓶颈。作者将其描述为面向材料的帕累托最优推理引擎，可高效采样候选材料。研究目标是加速无机新材料的发现流程，从而推动计算与储能等关键领域的技术突破。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.26402v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The discovery of novel inorganic materials drives technological breakthroughs in critical fields such as computing and energy storage. Generative AI has promised to accelerate the materials discovery pipeline, but state-of-the-art flow and diffusion models remain bottlenecked by the cost of proposing candidate materials. To address this, we introduce OMatG-flash, an all-atom flow map for inorganic crystal structure prediction (CSP) and de novo generation (DNG). OMatG-flash is a Pareto-optimal inference engine for materials, sampling candidate mat…
items.why_zh: 生成式 AI 材料发现的主要瓶颈在于候选材料采样成本，更高效的推理引擎有望显著加快新无机材料的发现节奏。
items.why_en: Sampling cost is the key bottleneck in generative materials discovery, so a more efficient inference engine could substantially accelerate the search for new inorganic materials.

items.title_zh: 从语调到轨迹：连续情感与货币政策沟通的形态
items.title_en: From Tone to Trajectory: Continuous Sentiment and the Shape of Monetary Policy Communication
items.summary_zh: 研究将欧洲央行与美联储记者会文本拆解为货币政策立场、经济前景和不确定性三个维度的“情感弧线”，考察情感在一份声明中的分布形态是否比平均语调携带更多政策相关信息。结果显示，弧线形态能够稳健地预测政策利率决策，并对通胀预期与预测者分歧具有预测力。作者认为，央行记者会不仅是信息发布，更是结构化的叙事。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.25034v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Central bank press conferences are not merely information releases --- they are structured narratives. We study whether the shape of sentiment within a statement, not just its average tone, carries policy-relevant signals. Constructing sentiment arcs for ECB and Fed press conferences along three dimensions --- monetary stance, economic outlook, and uncertainty --- we assess their predictive content for policy rate changes, inflation expectations, and forecaster disagreement. Our findings show that arc shape robustly predicts rate decisions beyo…
items.why_zh: 它提示央行沟通的“叙事结构”本身包含市场可用的政策信号，为理解与预测货币政策提供了新维度。
items.why_en: It suggests the narrative structure of central bank communication itself carries market-relevant policy signals, offering a new lens on monetary policy.

items.title_zh: Visual Jev：基于共享视觉上下文的高效准确决策
items.title_en: Visual Jev: Accurate and Efficient Decisions from Shared Visual Context
items.summary_zh: 许多视觉应用需要针对同一张图片提出多个相互独立的强制选择题。Visual Jev 只对图像和公开上下文编码一次，将各问题后缀作为批次独立执行，并从骨干网络的语言模型头读取候选项概率。在四个基准上，经答案监督的后训练把等权宏平均准确率从 70.6% 提升到 76.1%，增益集中在训练中覆盖的两类任务；当每张图有 32 个问题时，共享批量执行在热摊销时间下快 8.9 倍。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.25845v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many vision applications ask several independent, forced-choice questions about the same image. Visual Jev encodes the image and public context once, executes isolated question suffixes as a batch, and reads candidate probabilities from the backbone's language-model head. Across four benchmarks, answer-supervised post-training raises equal-weight macro accuracy from 70.6% to 76.1%, with the gain concentrated on the two task families represented in training. At N=32 questions per image, shared batched execution is 8.9x faster in warm amortized t…
items.why_zh: 它为“同一图像多问题”场景提供了兼顾准确率与推理效率的方案，可降低多任务视觉推理的算力开销。
items.why_en: It offers an accuracy- and efficiency-oriented approach for multi-question vision tasks, cutting the compute cost of batched visual reasoning.

items.title_zh: RepUCB：面向异构多任务线性赌博机的表征学习 UCB 算法
items.title_en: RepUCB: Representation Learning-Based UCB for Heterogeneous Multi-Task Linear Bandits
items.summary_zh: 论文研究异构线性赌博机中的多任务表征学习：T 个并发任务各有 d 维特征，其奖励参数共享一个维度为 r（远小于 min{d,T}）的公共隐表征，用以刻画任务间的相关性。作者提出 RepUCB，一种新的上置信界算法，通过表征学习利用任务共享结构来提升样本效率。该工作为替换版本，聚焦多任务线性赌博机的算法设计。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.00531v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multi-task representation learning exploits the shared structure among related tasks by learning a common latent representation, thereby improving sample efficiency. This paper introduces a novel approach to multi-task representation learning in heterogeneous linear bandits. We consider $T$ concurrent heterogeneous linear bandit tasks, each with feature dimension $d$, whose reward parameters share a common latent representation of dimension $r \ll \min\{d, T\}$, capturing the underlying task relatedness. We propose RepUCB, a novel Upper Confi…
items.why_zh: 在任务相关但参数异构的场景下，利用共享低维表征有望显著降低学习所需样本量。
items.why_en: Exploiting a shared low-dimensional representation can substantially reduce the samples needed when tasks are related but heterogeneous.

items.title_zh: 熵风险下最优策略识别的紧致样本复杂度界
items.title_en: Tight Sample Complexity Bounds for Entropic Best Policy Identification
items.summary_zh: 论文研究有限时域、熵风险度量下风险敏感强化学习的最优策略识别问题。此前工作发现，识别近似最优策略所需样本数在指数级时域依赖上，上下界之间存在常数因子差距：已知下界为 Ω(e^{|β|H})（H 为 MDP 时域），而借助生成模型的最优上界仅为 O(e^{2|β|H})。本文给出新结果以弥合这一差距。该文为替换版本。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.13717v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study best-policy identification for finite-horizon risk-sensitive reinforcement learning under the entropic risk measure. Recent work established a constant gap in the exponential horizon dependence between lower and upper bounds on the number of samples required to identify an approximately optimal policy. Precisely, known lower bounds scale in $\Omega(e^{|\beta| H})$ where $H$ is the horizon of the MDP, while the state-of-the-art upper bound achieves at best $O(e^{2|\beta| H})$ (arXiv:2506.00286v2) using a generative model. We show that…
items.why_zh: 弥合上下界差距有助于厘清风险敏感强化学习中样本复杂度的真实代价。
items.why_en: Closing the upper-lower bound gap clarifies the true sample-complexity cost of risk-sensitive reinforcement learning.

items.title_zh: VeriSoftBench：面向 Lean 的仓库级形式化验证基准
items.title_en: VeriSoftBench: Repository-Scale Formal Verification Benchmarks for Lean
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型在 Lean 等交互式定理证明中已取得显著成果，但现有用于评估 LLM 证明自动化的基准多取自 Mathlib 生态的数学内容，而软件验证中的证明通常位于定义丰富、含大量项目专属库的代码库中。为此，作者推出 VeriSoftBench，包含 500 个取自开源形式化方法项目的 Lean 4 证明义务，并保留真实的仓库上下文与跨文件依赖。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.18307v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models have achieved striking results in interactive theorem proving, particularly in Lean. However, most benchmarks for LLM-based proof automation are drawn from mathematics in the Mathlib ecosystem, whereas proofs in software verification are developed inside definition-rich codebases with substantial project-specific libraries. We introduce VeriSoftBench, a benchmark of 500 Lean 4 proof obligations drawn from open-source formal-methods developments and packaged to preserve realistic repository context and cross-file de…
items.why_zh: 它把 LLM 证明能力的评测从数学题扩展到真实软件验证仓库，更贴近实际工程难度。
items.why_en: It extends LLM proof-automation evaluation from math problems to realistic software-verification repositories, better reflecting engineering difficulty.

Its abrupt arrival caught many mathematicians by surprise. Researchers told The Verge the group is a good first step, but many said they were left with ba…

items.title_zh: 苹果推送 macOS 27.2 首个公测版：新增 16 段条形音量 / 亮度滑块
items.title_en: Apple Seeds First macOS 27.2 Public Beta With 16-Segment Volume and Brightness Sliders
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 23 日消息，科技媒体 9to5Mac 昨日（9 月 22 日）发布博文，报道称苹果公司推送 macOS 27.2 Golden Gate 首个公测版， 内部开发版本号为 26B5091g。 在更新内容方面，macOS 27.2 首个公测版扩展 Siri AI 的语言支持，从最初的英语外，扩展支持法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语五种新语言。 界面上， 首个公测版还引入全新音量与亮度滑块 ，采用“液态玻璃”（Liquid Glass）设计风格，16 段条形设计，视觉效果更现代化。IT之家附上相关视频如下： 修复方面，macOS 27.2 修复了“启动台”（launchpad）应用的动画问题。根据用户反馈，用户尝试通过四指捏合手势触发 Launchpad 后，动画会出现 "chopped up"（断裂 / 不流畅）的情况，最新版已修复该问题。 应用方面，信息（Messages）应用修复了联系人显示相关的 bug；而音乐（Music）应用支持将内容直接固定到侧边栏，方便用户快速访问。 在应用追踪透明度（ATT）方面，苹果宣布 macOS 27.2 为欧盟用户扩展应用提示框，并每年重新提示一次。法国、德国、意大利、波兰和罗马尼亚的用户必须使用此替代提示方式。
items.summary_en: Apple released the first public beta of macOS 27.2 "Golden Gate" (build 26B5091g). It expands Siri AI language support to French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish, adds 16-segment Liquid Glass-style volume and brightness sliders, and fixes Launchpad animation and Messages contact bugs. For EU users, Apple is extending App Tracking Transparency prompts that reappear annually, with mandatory alternative prompts in several countries.
items.why_zh: Siri 多语言扩展与欧盟 ATT 提示调整，显示苹果正在同时推进 AI 能力与合规本地化。
items.why_en: Broader Siri language support and revamped EU tracking prompts show Apple pushing AI features and regulatory compliance in parallel.

items.title_zh: 手游画质将迎新突破，高通第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版强化支持虚幻引擎 5
items.title_en: Qualcomm's 6th-Gen Snapdragon 8 Elite Boosts Unreal Engine 5 Support for Mobile Gaming
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 23 日消息，夏威夷时间 9 月 22 日 9 点（北京时间 9 月 23 日 3 点）召开的 2026 骁龙峰会上，高通公司宣布在其第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版芯片上， 强化支持虚幻引擎 5（Unreal Engine 5）支持。 高通为了提升 AI 渲染、超级分辨率与帧生成效果，为第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版芯片的 Adreno GPU 配备了专用 Adreno Matrix Cores，并推出 Adreno Neural Fusion 技术。IT之家附上相关截图如下： Adreno Neural Fusion 可以认为是适配第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版芯片的“DLSS 4”画质增强技术，在同一条图形渲染管线中整合神经网络处理、AI 超级分辨率和 AI 帧生成，目标是在提升画质和帧率的同时，降低渲染负载与功耗。 游戏不必始终以最高分辨率渲染，而是先以较低分辨率生成画面，再利用 AI 恢复细节、提升清晰度，并生成额外帧，从而兼顾画质与流畅度。 Adreno Neural Fusion 的硬件基础是 Adreno Matrix Cores ， 这是首次在 Adreno GPU 内加入面向 AI 计算的专用核心，用于直接运行图形相关的神经网络模型。 对于手游玩家而言，未来可以在搭载骁龙芯片的旗舰手机上，进一步增强 Nanite 虚拟化几何体、Lumen 全局光照、实时阴影…
items.summary_en: At Snapdragon Summit 2026, Qualcomm said its 6th-gen Snapdragon 8 Elite strengthens Unreal Engine 5 support. The chip's Adreno GPU gains dedicated Adreno Matrix Cores and Adreno Neural Fusion, which combines neural processing, AI super resolution and AI frame generation in one rendering pipeline—essentially a DLSS-like boost for mobile games.
items.why_zh: AI 超分与帧生成首次深度进入移动 GPU 渲染管线，可能显著改变手游的画质与功耗平衡。
items.why_en: AI upscaling and frame generation entering the mobile GPU pipeline could reshape the quality-power tradeoff in mobile gaming.

items.title_zh: 摩托罗拉 Signature 27 旗舰真机首秀，搭载高通第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版芯片

items.summary_en: At the Snapdragon Summit 2026 in Hawaii, Qualcomm unveiled its 6th-gen Snapdragon 8 Elite and Snapdragon 8 platforms, billed as the world's fastest mobile CPU. Motorola's Nicole Hagen announced the company is adopting the top-tier chip in its flagship line for the first time and showed the Motorola Signature 27, which features a 200MP sensor, a sloping back design and seven years of OS upgrades with Google Gemini.
items.why_zh: 作为首批搭载新旗舰芯片的机型，Signature 27 展示了终端侧 AI 与影像能力的下一阶段形态。
items.why_en: As an early flagship on the new chip, the Signature 27 previews the next stage of on-device AI and camera capability.

items.title_zh: 预填充吞吐超 330 Token/s：高通携手阶跃等为第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版端侧适配 300 亿参数 AI 模型
items.title_en: Over 330 Tokens/s Prefill: Qualcomm and Partners Bring a 30B-Parameter AI Model On-Device
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 23 日消息，夏威夷时间 9 月 22 日 9 点（北京时间 9 月 23 日 3 点）召开的 2026 骁龙峰会上，高通宣布携手阶跃、无量火及江波龙，基于第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版移动平台， 端侧适配与推理优化阶跃 StepEdge-Omni 30B-MoE 模型，并现场演示相关智能体助手。 该模型拥有 300 亿参数，依托混合专家架构，仅根据任务需要激活部分专家模块，以降低计算量和内存带宽需求。 合作方通过推理引擎、异构调度及存储方案优化，让模型运行内存需求较行业常规方案降低超过 50%，并支持在智能手机上稳定运行。 高通表示，该方案无需调用云端服务，可以在本地完成邮件理解、行程规划、日历同步、航班及酒店推荐、行程分享和邮件草拟等任务。 测试数据显示，模型预填充吞吐性能超过每秒 330 个 Token，解码吞吐性能超过每秒 28 个 Token。 IT之家注：“模型预填充吞吐性能是指大语言模型在推理的预填充（prefill）阶段，每秒能够处理的输入词元（token）数量， 是衡量系统处理长提示词（prompt）和批量请求能力的关键指标。 业内人士认为，大参数 MoE 模型在手机端的部署，有助于推动低时延和隐私保护型智能体应用发展。不过，实际规模化应用仍取决于终端成本、功耗、模型可靠性及用户接受度等因素。
items.summary_en: At Snapdragon Summit 2026, Qualcomm teamed up with StepFun and partners to bring StepEdge-Omni 30B-MoE, a 30-billion-parameter MoE model, on-device to the 6th-gen Snapdragon 8 Elite platform. Optimizations cut memory requirements by more than 50% versus conventional approaches, with measured prefill throughput above 330 tokens/s and decode above 28 tokens/s, enabling local agent tasks without cloud calls.
items.why_zh: 大参数 MoE 模型跑在手机上，有望推动低时延、隐私保护型的端侧智能体应用落地。
items.why_en: Running a large MoE model on a phone could enable low-latency, privacy-preserving on-device AI agents.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Sol 与 GPT-6 Luna，API 价格减半

items.title_zh: 小米 18 Pro 系列手机官宣全球首发高通第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版和第六代骁龙 8 至尊版处理器
items.title_en: Xiaomi 18 Pro Series to Debut Qualcomm's 6th-Gen Snapdragon 8 Elite Ultra and Snapdragon 8 Elite Worldwide
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 23 日消息，在今日的 2026 骁龙峰会上，小米集团高级副总裁、国际部总裁曾学忠宣布，小米将全球首发第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版和第六代骁龙 8 至尊版处理器， 首发机型为小米 18 Pro 系列 。 小米集团合伙人、总裁、手机部总裁、小米品牌总经理卢伟冰表示：“小米始终致力于在旗舰产品组合中为消费者带来突破性的创新，高通技术公司全新多旗舰策略让我们能够更加灵活地实现这一目标。 通过在即将推出的终端中采用第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版和第六代骁龙 8 至尊版 ，小米能够为更广泛的用户带来量身定制的差异化旗舰体验。我们正与高通技术公司携手，共同推动下一代 AI 赋能的智能手机的发展，带来前所未有的个性化和快速响应的体验。” 小米 18 Pro 系列已定档北京时间 9 月 23 日 19:00 在国内发布，IT之家在峰会现场获悉， 小米 18 Pro 系列将于年内登陆全球市场 。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Snapdragon Summit on September 23, Xiaomi announced it will be the first to launch Qualcomm's 6th-generation Snapdragon 8 Elite Ultra and Snapdragon 8 Elite chips, debuting in the Xiaomi 18 Pro series. Xiaomi president Lu Weibing said Qualcomm's new multi-flagship strategy lets the company deliver more differentiated flagship experiences, as both firms push next-generation AI-powered smartphones. The Xiaomi 18 Pro series launches in China at 19:00 Beijing time on September 23 and will reach global markets within the year.
items.why_zh: 首发高通最新旗舰芯片，是小米争夺高端与端侧 AI 体验话语权的关键一步。
items.why_en: Landing Qualcomm's newest flagship silicon first is a key move for Xiaomi in the high-end and on-device AI race.

items.title_zh: 全球最快移动 CPU：高通发布第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版芯片，CPU 行业首超 5GHz、GPU 性能提升 44%
items.title_en: Qualcomm Unveils 6th-Gen Snapdragon 8 Elite Ultra: First Mobile CPU Above 5GHz, GPU Up 44%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 23 日消息，夏威夷时间 9 月 22 日 9 点（北京时间 9 月 23 日 3 点）召开的 2026 骁龙峰会上，高通公司宣布推出第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版移动平台和第六代骁龙 8 至尊版移动平台， 官方表示这是“全球最快移动 CPU”。 高通称两款产品面向“智能体人工智能”时代的移动终端需求，主要应用于下一代旗舰智能手机。 IT之家援引博文介绍，第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版定位为其性能最强的移动平台之一，重点提升终端侧人工智能、移动游戏和影像处理能力。 其中，平台搭载的 Adreno Neural Fusion 技术可利用人工智能辅助图形渲染；结合高级专业视频编解码器和智能像素控制技术，平台还可支持更复杂的场景理解及影像处理。 第六代骁龙 8 至尊版同样采用 2 纳米制程工艺，并配备定制版 Qualcomm Oryon 中央处理器、Adreno 图形处理器和 Hexagon 神经网络处理器。高通表示，该平台将在更广泛的旗舰机型中支持人工智能、游戏、影像和连接等功能。 CPU 方面， 高通宣布第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版的最高主频超过 5.0GHz，性能提升 13%、能效提升 37%、响应速度提升 15%。 GPU 方面， 高通宣布 Adreno GPU 性能提升 44%，能效提升 40%。 高通技术公司高级副总裁兼手机业务总经理 Chris Patrick 表示…
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Snapdragon Summit, Qualcomm introduced the Snapdragon 8 Elite Ultra and Snapdragon 8 Elite mobile platforms, calling the top tier the world's fastest mobile CPU and targeting the "agentic AI" era of flagship phones. Both are built on a 2nm process with custom Qualcomm Oryon CPUs, Adreno GPUs and Hexagon NPUs; the Ultra adds Adreno Neural Fusion for AI-assisted graphics rendering. Qualcomm claims CPU clocks above 5.0GHz, 13% better CPU performance, 37% better CPU efficiency, 15% faster response, and a 44% GPU performance gain with 40% better GPU efficiency.
items.why_zh: CPU 主频首次突破 5GHz、AI 深度介入渲染，标志着移动芯片正式转向端侧智能体计算。
items.why_en: Crossing 5GHz and baking AI into rendering marks mobile silicon's formal pivot toward on-device agentic computing.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5.5：成本降低 40%，取消 5 小时使用上限
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Opus 5.5, Cuts Costs 40% and Scraps 5-Hour Usage Caps
items.summary_zh: 据 Benzinga 报道，Anthropic 推出新一代模型 Claude Opus 5.5，称其成本较此前降低约 40%，同时取消了 5 小时的使用时长限制。这意味着用户在连续使用上有了更宽松的空间，而单位调用成本也明显下降。该调整被认为有助于 Anthropic 在企业级与高频开发者场景中提升竞争力。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Opus 5.5, Cuts Costs 40% and Scraps 5-Hour Usage Caps Benzinga
items.why_zh: 大幅降价并放开使用时长限制，直接降低了前沿模型的采用门槛。
items.why_en: A big price cut plus relaxed usage limits directly lowers the barrier to adopting frontier models.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 为银行提供捷径，绕开耗资数十亿的核心系统重写
items.title_en: OpenAI Hands Banks a Shortcut Around Billion-Dollar Core Rewrites
items.summary_zh: 据 PYMNTS.com 报道，OpenAI 正为银行业提供一条绕开核心系统大规模重写的路径，使银行无需投入高达数十亿美元的核心系统改造，也能接入其 AI 能力。此举瞄准的是金融机构长期依赖、改造成本极高的传统核心银行系统。报道未披露具体合作银行、技术方案或时间表。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Hands Banks a Shortcut Around Billion-Dollar Core Rewrites PYMNTS.com
items.why_zh: 若成立，这将让 AI 绕过金融机构最昂贵的技术改造环节，加速其在核心业务中的落地。
items.why_en: If it holds, this lets AI bypass finance's most expensive modernization hurdle and speeds adoption in core operations.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Opus 5.5：成本更低、性能更高
items.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5 at lower cost, higher performance
items.summary_zh: 据 qz.com 报道，Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5.5，主打更低的调用成本与更强的性能表现。该模型延续了 Anthropic 在 Opus 系列上推进前沿能力的路线，同时通过价格下调提升性价比。具体性能指标与定价细节在不同报道中有所差异，但降价与性能提升是本次更新的核心。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5 at lower cost, higher performance qz.com
items.why_zh: 前沿模型“更强且更便宜”正成为常态，推动 AI 能力在真实业务中大规模铺开。
items.why_en: Frontier models getting both better and cheaper is what pushes AI into large-scale real-world deployment.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 模型，API 价格大降 50%
items.title_en: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Sol and Luna Models, Cutting API Prices by 50%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 23 日消息，OpenAI 今日发布 GPT-6 系列模型的最新成员 GPT-6 Sol 和 GPT-6 Luna 。 OpenAI 官方表示，两款模型采用与 GPT-6 Astra 类似的方法进行训练，将 Astra 在专业工作、事实性、编码、计算机使用和对齐等方面 最先进的性能带入更快、更经济的模型 。 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 模型的 API 价格相比 GPT-5.6 促销价降低 50% 。不过 OpenAI 官方也表示，GPT-6 Astra 依然是其整体上最优秀的模型，如果你想要最佳效果和无妥协的体验，还是建议选择 GPT-6 Astra。 性能方面，在 AutomationBench 的跨应用业务流程测试中，GPT-6 Sol 在 xhigh 强度下表现优于 Claude Opus 5， 成本仅为 Opus 5 每任务成本的 9% 。在 high 强度下，GPT-6 Luna 比前代提升了 5.4%，且每项任务成本降低了 58%。 在评估智能体的 Last Exam 测试中，GPT-6 Sol 在 max effort 状态下得分为 56.4%，高于 Claude Opus 5 在评估中的最高分，每任务成本也降低 60%。 在事实可靠性方面，GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 模型也取得进展。在 OpenAI 基于去标识化的真实世界对话中， GP…
items.summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, trained with an approach similar to GPT-6 Astra, bringing Astra's frontier performance in professional work, factuality, coding, computer use and alignment to faster, cheaper models. API prices are 50% below GPT-5.6's promotional pricing, though OpenAI says Astra remains its best overall model. OpenAI cites Sol outperforming Claude Opus 5 on AutomationBench cross-app workflows at xhigh effort at 9% of the per-task cost, and scoring 56.4% on Last Exam at max effort, 60% cheaper per task than Opus 5, while Luna improves 5.4% over its predecessor at high effort with 58% lower per-task cost.
items.why_zh: 在逼近前沿性能的同时把价格砍半，直接改写智能体应用的成本结构。
items.why_en: Halving prices while approaching frontier performance rewrites the cost structure of agentic applications.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5.5：以更低价格实现顶级性能
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Opus 5.5 With Fable-Level Performance at a Lower Price
items.summary_zh: 据 MacRumors 报道，Anthropic 推出 Claude Opus 5.5，称其在更低价格下达到顶级（Fable 级）性能表现。该模型被定位为面向高要求任务的高性价比选择，延续了 Anthropic 在 Opus 系列上持续提升能力与降低使用成本的方向。报道未披露更细的基准数据与具体定价。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Opus 5.5 With Fable-Level Performance at a Lower Price MacRumors
items.why_zh: 顶级能力配合更低价格，将进一步加剧前沿大模型之间的性价比竞争。
items.why_en: Top-tier capability at a lower price intensifies the price-performance battle among frontier models.

items.title_zh: 高通宣布全球 Snapdragon Insider 项目成员数量突破 2300 万
items.title_en: Qualcomm: Snapdragon Insider Program Tops 23 Million Members, Creators Surpass 405 Million
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 23 日消息，夏威夷时间 9 月 22 日 9 点（北京时间 9 月 23 日 3 点）召开的 2026 骁龙峰会上，IT之家带来前方现场报道，在活动演讲中， 高通公布宣布全球 Snapdragon Insider 项目成员数量突破 2300 万；全球 Snapdragon Creators 数量突破 4.05 亿。 Snapdragon Insiders 是高通围绕骁龙平台运营的社区与内容计划，其作用包括： 向成员提供新品、技术和活动的优先资讯，以及与品牌互动的机会。 在 Snapdragon Summit 等活动中，把终端用户、开发者、OEM 合作伙伴、创作者、分析师和媒体汇集在一起。 让高通能直接获得用户对移动芯片、PC、音频、XR、汽车与端侧 AI 功能的反馈，并持续强化 Snapdragon 的消费者品牌认知。 在 2026 高通骁龙峰会上，高通将叙事重点放在 “ Snapdragon for the Agentic Age ” ：不仅强调芯片性能，也强调能够在手机和 PC 等终端上运行的个人 AI 与智能体式 AI 体验。 Snapdragon Creators 是指全球大量用 Snapdragon 手机、PC、笔记本等设备进行拍照、拍视频、剪片、直播、做音乐、打游戏等创作的创作者和科技爱好者。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Snapdragon Summit, Qualcomm announced that its Snapdragon Insider program has surpassed 23 million members, while Snapdragon Creators exceed 405 million. The summit focused on "Snapdragon for the Agentic Age," highlighting personal and agentic AI experiences on devices. Snapdragon Insiders is a community program that gives members early access to products and events and provides Qualcomm with direct user feedback.
items.why_zh: 凸显骁龙生态社区规模及高通在智能体 AI 时代的战略重心。
items.why_en: Highlights the scale of Qualcomm's Snapdragon community and its strategic focus on the agentic AI era.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布更快更高效的 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 模型
items.title_en: OpenAI launches faster and more efficient GPT-6 Sol and Luna models.
items.summary_zh: 据 The Verge 报道，OpenAI 发布了 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 两款新模型，并称其速度更快、效率更高。目前报道未提供具体的性能指标、模型参数或可用范围。OpenAI 也未公布这些模型的定价和上线时间等细节。对于开发者和企业用户而言，新模型的实际表现和成本将决定其采用意愿。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launches faster and more efficient GPT-6 Sol and Luna models. theverge.com
items.why_zh: 新模型若如宣称般更快更高效，可能进一步推动 AI 应用普及。
items.why_en: If the new models deliver on speed and efficiency, they could further drive AI adoption.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna，API 价格下调 50%
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol And Luna With 50% Lower API Pricing
items.summary_zh: 据 Pulse 2.0 报道，OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 模型，并将 API 价格下调 50%。这表明 OpenAI 在提升模型能力的同时，也在降低开发者使用成本，以扩大其 AI 模型的采用率。具体模型细节尚未披露，包括性能指标、上下文窗口和可用性等。此次降价可能对依赖 API 的初创公司和开发者产生直接影响。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol And Luna With 50% Lower API Pricing Pulse 2.0
items.why_zh: 大幅降价可能加剧 AI 模型 API 市场的价格竞争。
items.why_en: The significant price cut could intensify competition in the AI model API market.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 在 Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5.5 后几分钟推出 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna Minutes After Anthropic Drops Claude Opus 5.5
items.summary_zh: 据 Yahoo Finance 报道，在 Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5.5 后几分钟内，OpenAI 便推出了 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 模型。这一紧凑的时间点凸显了 AI 大模型领域激烈的竞争态势。目前关于新模型的具体能力、定价和可用范围等信息尚不完整。两大公司的接连发布，可能推动行业进一步加速创新。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna Minutes After Anthropic Drops Claude Opus 5.5 Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 两大 AI 公司几乎同时发布新品，显示大模型竞赛持续升温。
items.why_en: The near-simultaneous launches by two major AI companies show the escalating large-model race.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna，主打更低成本和更少错误
items.title_en: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna, boasting lower cost and fewer mistakes
items.summary_zh: 据 TechCrunch 报道，OpenAI 正式发布 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 模型，并宣称其具备更低的成本和更少的错误。这一定位旨在吸引对价格和可靠性敏感的开发者和企业用户。目前具体的性能基准、错误率改善幅度以及可用性细节尚未公布。若这些宣称得到验证，将有助于 OpenAI 在竞争激烈的 AI 市场中保持优势。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna, boasting lower cost and fewer mistakes TechCrunch
items.why_zh: 若成本与准确性同时改善，将降低企业采用 AI 的门槛。
items.why_en: If both cost and accuracy improve, it would lower the barrier for enterprise AI adoption.

items.title_zh: Palo Alto Networks 推出 AI 服务，用于搜寻网络安全漏洞
items.title_en: Palo Alto Networks launches AI service to hunt for cyber vulnerabilities
items.summary_zh: 据 Calcalistech 报道，Palo Alto Networks 推出了一项 AI 服务，旨在帮助企业发现和排查网络安全漏洞。该服务利用人工智能技术，有望提升漏洞检测的效率和覆盖面。目前关于该服务的具体功能、定价和可用性等细节尚未完全披露。随着网络攻击日益复杂，将 AI 用于漏洞挖掘可能成为安全行业的新趋势。
items.summary_en: Palo Alto Networks launches AI service to hunt for cyber vulnerabilities calcalistech.com
items.why_zh: 将 AI 用于漏洞挖掘，可能改变网络安全防御的攻防节奏。
items.why_en: Applying AI to vulnerability hunting could change the pace of cyber offense and defense.

items.title_zh: 田纳西州推出 AI 聊天机器人 Iris，协助专业执照办理
items.title_en: Meet Iris: Tennessee launches AI chatbot for professional licensing help
items.summary_zh: 据 WZTV 报道，美国田纳西州推出了一款名为 Iris 的 AI 聊天机器人，旨在帮助用户处理专业执照相关的咨询和申请流程。该工具期望简化政府服务，提升办事效率。目前其具体功能和上线范围尚未详细说明。这是政府部门利用 AI 改善公共服务的最新案例之一。
items.summary_en: Meet Iris: Tennessee launches AI chatbot for professional licensing help WZTV
items.why_zh: 政府服务引入 AI 聊天机器人，是 AI 落地公共事务的又一案例。
items.why_en: The use of an AI chatbot in government services marks another case of AI adoption in public affairs.

items.why_zh: 一条汇总覆盖多个热点，显示科技行业快速变化与竞争。

items.title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5.5，称以更低价格实现旗舰级性能
items.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5, promising Fable-level performance at a lower price
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出新模型 Claude Opus 5.5，官方称其在保持旗舰级性能的同时显著降低了使用价格。据 Mashable 报道，该模型主打“更低成本、同级表现”，意在降低开发者与企业调用前沿模型的门槛。目前公开摘要中未披露具体定价、能力评测数据与开放范围等细节。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5, promising Fable-level performance at a lower price Mashable
items.why_zh: 前沿模型价格持续下探，直接影响开发者和企业的模型选型与成本结构。
items.why_en: Falling prices for frontier models directly shape how developers and enterprises choose and budget for AI.

items.title_zh: AI infrastructure firm Accelevation targets up to $5.4 billion valuation in US IPO
items.title_en: AI infrastructure firm Accelevation targets up to $5.4 billion valuation in US IPO
items.summary_zh: AI infrastructure firm Accelevation targets up to $5.4 billion valuation in US IPO Reuters
items.summary_en: AI infrastructure company Accelevation is targeting a valuation of up to $5.4 billion in a US IPO, Reuters reported. The listing adds to a wave of AI-infrastructure firms seeking public-market capital.
items.why_zh: AI 基建公司的估值与上市进度，是观察 AI 资本热潮冷热的重要风向标。
items.why_en: The valuation and IPO progress of AI-infrastructure firms are a key gauge of the AI capital cycle.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 在 IPO 前发布更便宜的新模型 Claude Opus 5.5
items.title_en: Anthropic unveils new, cheaper Claude Opus 5.5 ahead of IPO (ANTHRO:Private)
items.summary_zh: 据 Seeking Alpha 报道，Anthropic 在公司 IPO 之前发布了新一代 Claude Opus 5.5 模型，主打更低的使用成本，报道标题强调这是一款“更便宜”的新模型。除价格定位外，目前公开信息未披露更多技术参数、能力表现或定价细节。该模型的发布时点紧贴 Anthropic 的上市筹备期。
items.summary_en: Anthropic unveils new, cheaper Claude Opus 5.5 ahead of IPO (ANTHRO:Private) Seeking Alpha
items.why_zh: 在 IPO 前推出更便宜的旗舰模型，意味着 Anthropic 正以价格与产品迭代争夺企业级市场份额。
items.why_en: Releasing a cheaper flagship model right before an IPO signals Anthropic is competing on price as well as capability for enterprise customers.

items.title_zh: a16z 创办“无作业”学院，联合 Palantir、Google、Meta 等 10 家伙伴
items.title_en: Andreessen Horowitz is launching an ‘academy’ with no homework and partnerships with Palantir, Google, and Meta
items.summary_zh: 风投机构 Andreessen Horowitz（a16z）正在筹建一所“学院”，定位为年轻人创建或加入硅谷初创公司的通道。名为“Horowitz Andreessen Academy”的项目首批有 10 家合作方，包括 Anduril、Anthropic、Coinbase、Google、Meta、NVIDIA、OpenAI、Palantir、Replit 和 Stripe，并由 a16z 领投 4200 万美元资金。学院虽被描述为“高度选拔”，但不授予学位或认证；学生将参加由 OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 等科技人物主讲的短期课程，以及提供岗位角色的“co-ops”实践项目。
items.summary_en: Venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) is creating an "academy" positioned as a pipeline for young people to build or join a Silicon Valley startup. The "Horowitz Andreessen Academy" will launch with 10 partners, including Anduril, Anthropic, Coinbase, Google, Meta, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Palantir, Replit, and Stripe, along with $42 million in funding led by a16z. Instead, students will attend short classes led by tech figureheads, like OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, as well as "co-ops" that give students rol…
items.why_zh: 风投机构亲自下场办“人才管道”，显示 AI 时代硅谷对年轻技术人才的争夺正前移到教育环节。
items.why_en: A VC firm building its own talent pipeline shows Silicon Valley's competition for young technical talent is moving upstream into education.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 在 IPO 前夕发布更便宜的 AI 模型
items.title_en: Anthropic releases cheaper AI model ahead of IPO
items.summary_zh: 据《金融时报》报道，Anthropic 在筹备 IPO 期间推出了一款价格更低的 AI 模型，意在吸引对成本敏感的开发者和企业客户。降价的时点颇为关键：上市之前，公司需要用更广泛的用户采用与收入增长来支撑估值叙事。这一动作也加剧了前沿模型厂商之间的价格竞争。
items.summary_en: Anthropic releases cheaper AI model ahead of IPO Financial Times
items.why_zh: 上市前的定价策略显示，模型厂商的竞争重心正从纯性能转向性价比与商业化规模。
items.why_en: Pre-IPO pricing moves show AI model competition shifting from raw capability toward cost-effectiveness and commercial scale.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Opus 5.5：CEO Amodei 呼吁放缓 AI 之后的首个模型
items.title_en: Anthropic launches Opus 5.5, its first model since CEO Amodei called for AI slowdown
items.summary_zh: 据 Yahoo Finance 报道，Anthropic 发布了 Claude Opus 5.5，这是公司 CEO Dario Amodei 公开呼吁为 AI 发展“减速”之后推出的首个模型。报道以标题形式强调了这一时间点上的对照意味。除此之外，原文未提供更多关于模型能力、定价或安全措施的细节。该发布也与 Anthropic 筹备 IPO 的节点重合。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launches Opus 5.5, its first model since CEO Amodei called for AI slowdown Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 一边呼吁放缓、一边照常发新模型，Anthropic 的动作再次引发对“安全主张与商业竞争是否自洽”的讨论。
items.why_en: Urging caution while shipping a new flagship model renews debate over whether AI safety rhetoric and commercial competition can coexist.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5.5，加强网络安全防护
items.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5 with stricter safeguards for cybersecurity
items.summary_zh: The Verge 报道，Anthropic 推出 Claude Opus 5.5，并为其配备了更严格的网络安全相关防护措施。报道聚焦于该模型在安全护栏上的收紧，即在发布新一代旗舰模型的同时加强管控。原文未披露具体模型参数、定价或安全政策的技术细节。这一做法延续了 Anthropic 一贯强调“负责任部署”的产品路线。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5 with stricter safeguards for cybersecurity The Verge
items.why_zh: 在模型能力竞赛之外，安全护栏的宽严已成为厂商差异化竞争与监管关注的关键点。
items.why_en: Beyond raw capability, how tight a model's safety guardrails are has become a key differentiator and a focus of regulators.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 在 IPO 前推出成本效益更高的 Opus 5.5 模型
items.title_en: Anthropic Unveils More Cost-Efficient Opus 5.5 Model Before IPO
items.summary_zh: 彭博社报道，Anthropic 在公司上市前发布了成本效益更高的 Opus 5.5 模型。报道强调该模型在“性价比”上的改进，指向企业客户对推理成本日益敏感的现实。发布时点与 Anthropic 的 IPO 筹备期重合，被视为上市前展示产品进展的动作。原文未给出具体定价与性能数据。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Unveils More Cost-Efficient Opus 5.5 Model Before IPO Bloomberg.com
items.why_zh: 推理成本是 AI 商业化落地的最大瓶颈之一，以“更便宜”为卖点直接回应了企业采购的核心关切。
items.why_en: Inference cost is one of the biggest barriers to AI commercialization, so a cheaper model speaks directly to enterprise buyers' core concern.

items.title_zh: 后摩智能确认其下代大模型端边 AI 芯片采用 3D CIM 存算一体架构
items.title_en: Houmo.ai confirms 3D CIM compute-in-memory architecture for its next-gen edge AI chip
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，后摩智能 ( HOUMO.AI ) 在近日举行的 2026 全球 AI 芯片峰会上确认，该公司 下代大模型端边 AI 芯片将采用 3D CIM 存算一体架构 ，结合融合存算与 3D DRAM 技术。 这款新一代旗舰芯片将具备端侧超实时思考和互动能力。通过垂直堆叠，其 可在同等面积下实现 2 倍算力 ，还有望进一步优化功耗与散热压力。 IT之家注意到，后摩智能 2025 年 7 月发布了后摩漫界 M50 芯片。这一芯片典型功耗 10W，可提供 160TOPS (INT8) 或 100TFLOPS (bFP16) 算力，支持 48GB 内存容量、153.6GB/s 内存带宽。该芯片目前已获得超 150 款产品定点，覆盖丰富应用场景。 相关阅读： 《 零刻推出 SEi13 AI / SEi14 AI 迷你主机：搭载最高 160TOPS 算力独立 NPU，11895 元起 》 《 联想 AI 主机家族正式发布：搭载天禧 AI 4.0、支持“一键养虾” 》
items.summary_en: At the 2026 Global AI Chip Summit, Houmo.ai (后摩智能) confirmed its next-generation edge AI chip for large models will use a 3D CIM compute-in-memory architecture combining compute-in-memory with 3D DRAM. The company says vertical stacking doubles compute at the same area while easing power and thermal pressure. Its July 2025 M50 chip delivers 160 TOPS (INT8) or 100 TFLOPS (bFP16) at 10W typical power and has over 150 design wins.
items.why_zh: 存算一体加 3D 堆叠是绕开先进制程与内存带宽瓶颈的路径之一，落地后将直接影响端侧大模型的算力上限。
items.why_en: Compute-in-memory plus 3D stacking is one route around process and memory-bandwidth limits, and could directly raise the compute ceiling for on-device large models.

items.title_zh: 拿下 2 亿日活跃用户后，消息称字节跳动豆包收缩对话团队
items.title_en: ByteDance's Doubao reportedly shrinks its chat team after passing 200M DAU
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，《晚点 LatePost》今天（22 日）晚间发布消息称，豆包通用 Session 团队正在减员，规模预计减半。该团队此前约有 50 人， 一度是豆包内规模最大的团队 ，主要负责豆包的对话（Chat）产品能力，包括策略、评测等工作。此次调整后，部分人员将转岗至豆包商业化、飞书等团队，其余人员将被裁撤。 消息称豆包负责人赵祺推动了此次人员调整。他在字节已有十余年履历，此前负责增长中台、穿山甲（字节旗下广告平台），之后转岗至集团人力资源部门，为字节 AI 业务搭建人才体系。2025 年 9 月，赵祺转岗至豆包，后于今年 7 月飞书、豆包产品团队整合后成为新产品团队负责人。 赵祺在转岗到豆包后依旧看中人效，拆散了豆包此前的独立评测团队，并将其分到各业务组。 IT之家从报道中获悉，负责对话方向的产品后训练团队（Product Posttrain-Chat）也在缩减。该团队由朱文佳负责，隶属于大模型部门 Seed，与豆包产品团队协作，基于 Seed 的基础模型进行后训练， 产出供豆包直接调用的小模型 。由于业务需求减少，部分员工已转岗至 Horizon RL、产品后训练-办公（Product Posttrain-Work）等其他部门。另据了解，对话模型合版负责人在一个月内换了两次。 豆包凭借超 2 亿的 DAU，目前已跻身国内日活跃用户数最高 AI 应用之列。…
items.summary_en: ByteDance's Doubao is cutting its general Session team—once its largest, at roughly 50 people and responsible for chat product capabilities—by about half, LatePost reports. Some staff are moving to Doubao commercialization and Feishu, while others are being laid off; the Product Posttrain-Chat team is also shrinking. Doubao's lead Zhao Qi drove the adjustment. Doubao now has over 200 million DAU.
items.why_zh: 在用户规模登顶后转向商业化与人效优化，说明国内 AI 应用竞争的焦点正从“抢用户”切换到“算账”。
items.why_en: Shifting to monetization and efficiency after reaching peak scale shows China's AI app race is moving from user acquisition to unit economics.

items.title_zh: 联合国秘书长古特雷斯呼吁全球监管人工智能，避免出现杀人机器人
items.title_en: UN Chief Guterres Calls for Global AI Regulation, Warns of 'Killer Robots'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，据彭博社报道，联合国秘书长进一步呼吁对人工智能实施监管，以避免出现企业权力泛滥、杀人机器人横行的反乌托邦未来。 安东尼奥 · 古特雷斯（Antonio Guterres）在联合国大会上向各国领导人发表卸任前最后一次讲话，就人工智能的各类风险发出警示。他提出，前沿大模型的飞速发展，有可能削弱主权国家的治理能力。 “我们正在目睹权力正大规模从各国政府手中，转移到少数私营企业与个人手里。”古特雷斯于当地时间周二发言时呼吁各方达成国际共识，建立全新的人工智能安全保障机制。 “这项技术发展速度极快，其全部影响超出了我们的理解能力。”他补充道。 据IT之家了解，这位 77 岁的联合国领导人已经执掌联合国十年。他描绘了一幅黯淡的世界图景：战火连绵、饥饿被当作武器、气候变化持续加剧，人权与法治不断遭到漠视。他特别指出，人工智能以及数据中心军备竞赛已经成为剧烈变革时代的核心力量。同时，他含蓄地谈及中美两国，呼吁设立约束机制，保障这项技术能够安全发展。 “拥有最强人工智能能力的政府，对全人类负有最大责任，应当搭建对话、透明互信以及合作的沟通渠道。”他表示。 就在研究人员向顶尖 AI 开发企业发出警告：如果不加管控，人工智能有可能致使人类灭绝之后，各国领导人齐聚纽约，出席联合国年度大会，各界的焦虑情绪持续升温。 2022 年凭借 ChatGPT 开启人工智能时代的 Ope…
items.summary_en: In his final UN General Assembly address, Secretary-General Antonio Guterres urged global regulation of AI to prevent corporate power overreach and a future of 'killer robots.' He warned that frontier models are eroding governments' governing capacity and called for international consensus on new AI safety safeguards.
items.why_zh: 联合国最高层公开呼吁建立全球 AI 安全机制，凸显治理权正从国家向少数科技企业转移的焦虑。
items.why_en: The UN's top official publicly pressing for global AI safety mechanisms highlights fears that governance power is shifting from states to a handful of tech firms.

items.title_en: Meta Shares Up Over 20% as Wall Street Bets on AI Agent Muse
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，据路透社今天（22 日）晚间报道，华尔街开始看好 Meta，投资者押注其新推出的 AI 智能体 Muse 有望为其开辟新的收入来源，并改变 Meta 在 AI 领域的商业化前景。 9 月 8 日上线的 Muse 是一款 AI 助手，可以代替用户发送电子邮件、预订旅行，还能完成出售汽车等交易。基础版本免费，针对使用需求更高的用户，Meta 提供每月 20 美元或 100 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 134.2 元或 671 元人民币） 两档订阅方案。 Muse 上线后，Meta 股价 累计上涨超过 20% ，同期涨幅超过“美股七巨头”中的其他科技公司。截至最近一个交易日收盘，Meta 市值增加超过 2,000 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1.34 万亿元人民币） ，股价也升至 7 个多月以来最高水平。 周二早盘，Meta 股价再涨 1.5%，此前一个交易日的涨幅超过 11%。 摩根大通分析师报告称：“尽管现在还处于早期阶段，但我们认为，Muse 有潜力 成为 ChatGPT 之后使用最广泛的消费级 AI 应用 。”分析师认为，Muse 上线初期迅速吸引用户，主要得益于较高的产品与市场契合度、Meta 庞大的分发渠道，以及免费版本降低了用户首次体验和持续使用的门槛。 Apptopia 数据显示，Muse 目前仅面向美国和加拿大用户开放，上线前 12 天累计…
items.summary_en: Meta's AI assistant Muse, launched September 8, can send emails, book travel and even handle car sales, with a free tier and $20/$100 monthly subscriptions. Meta shares have risen over 20% since launch, adding more than $200 billion in market value. JPMorgan sees Muse as a potential ChatGPT-scale consumer AI app.
items.why_zh: 若 Muse 被验证为可规模化的消费级 AI 入口，将改变 Meta 的 AI 商业化前景与市场预期。
items.why_en: If Muse proves a scalable consumer AI gateway, it could reshape Meta's AI monetization prospects and investor expectations.

items.title_zh: 圆桌讨论：虚拟边境墙的致命失败
items.title_en: Roundtables: The Deadly Failures of The Virtual Border Wall
items.summary_zh: 美国在过去25年里花费数十亿美元，沿南部边境建造由监视塔组成的“虚拟墙”，并承诺这些设施将帮助发现和逮捕越境者、挽救生命。但《麻省理工科技评论》的一项开创性调查记录了超过1000人曾穿行于这些监视塔覆盖的区域，却未被联系或逮捕，最终在那里死亡。其中一些人甚至处于新安装的AI驱动监视塔之下，这些塔的设计目标正是自动识别人员。调查结果揭示了一场比此前所知更为明显的人道主义危机。
items.summary_en: The US has spent billions building a “virtual wall” of surveillance towers along its southern border over the past 25 years, promising they will help detect and apprehend border crossers and save lives. But a groundbreaking investigation by MIT Technology Review has documented over a thousand people who moved through areas watched by these towers without being reached or apprehended, and who ultimately died there. Some were even under the watch of newly installed AI-powered towers designed to spot people automatically. Our findings reveal a humanitarian crisis more visible than previously know…
items.why_zh: 该调查揭示大规模边境监控与AI自动识别并未如承诺般挽救生命，反而暴露了致命的人道主义后果。
items.why_en: The investigation shows that massive border surveillance and AI-powered detection have failed to save lives as promised, exposing deadly humanitarian consequences.

items.title_zh: Barracuda 推出 AI Data Security，管控员工向聊天机器人发送的数据
items.title_en: Barracuda launches AI Data Security to control what employees send to chatbots
items.summary_zh: 据 SiliconANGLE 报道，安全厂商 Barracuda 发布名为 AI Data Security 的新产品，用于管理和控制员工向聊天机器人等生成式 AI 工具发送的数据。该产品瞄准企业在采用 AI 工具时普遍担忧的数据泄露与合规风险。随着生成式 AI 在办公场景普及，防止敏感信息经外部模型外流，正成为企业安全预算的新增项。
items.summary_en: Barracuda launches AI Data Security to control what employees send to chatbots SiliconANGLE
items.why_zh: 生成式 AI 的普及带来新的数据外泄面，相关管控工具正成为企业安全的新刚需。
items.why_en: Generative AI creates a new data-leakage surface, making such controls a growing enterprise security requirement.

items.title_zh: 体验价 499 元：OPPO 推出“AI 心力球”可穿戴新品，主打“AI 成长教练”
items.title_en: OPPO Launches 'AI Mind Ball' Wearable at 499 Yuan, Positioned as an 'AI Growth Coach'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 22 日消息，OPPO 今天召开新品发布会，除了推出 Find X10 系列手机新品以外，OPPO 本次还带来了全新品类穿戴产品“AI 心力球”。 新品体验价为 499 元 ，主打卖点是“AI 成长教练”，能够帮助用户思考，把事情做成。 即日起开启用户招募 。 IT之家在发布会现场了解到， OPPO AI 心力球是一款别在衣服领口的穿戴产品 。其重量为 9.8g，支持 24 小时全天续航、5 米远距离收音。 这款产品能够帮助用户聚焦事情、帮用户提醒承诺、发现风险，和用户一起复盘过去的判断和后来的结果。 同时，这款产品搭载 PersonaX 记忆共生引擎，配备声纹识别算法、信息关联算法以及记忆演化算法，配备 VAD 人声检测，支持存算一体架构，还带有 O-Mind 仿生行为深度思考算法，提供个性化行动建议。 值得注意的是，OPPO 还将对这款产品开放 MCP 生态，让开发者能够接入常用 AI 工具。该产品搭载 PCC 私密计算云，号称“从存储到传输到运算全链路加密、不留存任何用户录音”。
items.summary_en: On September 22, OPPO unveiled a new wearable category called the 'AI Mind Ball' at a price of 499 yuan, now open for user recruitment. Positioned as an 'AI growth coach,' it is a 9.8g clip-on device with 24-hour battery life and 5-meter far-field audio pickup, designed to help users focus, remember commitments, spot risks, and review past judgments. It features the PersonaX memory engine, voiceprint and memory evolution algorithms, an O-Mind biomimetic deep-thinking algorithm, and a PCC private compute cloud with end-to-end encryption that claims not to retain any user recordings. OPPO will also open an MCP ecosystem for developers to integrate common AI tools.
items.why_zh: OPPO 以低门槛穿戴设备切入“AI 成长教练”场景，并开放 MCP 生态与私密计算云，显示 AI 硬件正从功能叠加转向持续陪伴与个人数据隐私保护。
items.why_en: OPPO is entering the 'AI growth coach' space with a low-cost wearable, opening an MCP ecosystem and emphasizing private computing, signaling a shift in AI hardware toward persistent companionship and personal data privacy.

items.title_zh: Global X 推出人工智能内存指数 ETF（DRAM）及其他六只 ETF
items.title_en: Global X Launches Global X Artificial Intelligence Memory Index ETF (DRAM), and Six Other ETFs
items.summary_zh: 根据 TradingView 报道，Global X 推出了名为 Global X Artificial Intelligence Memory Index ETF 的新产品，交易代码为 DRAM，同时还推出了另外六只 ETF。该 ETF 聚焦人工智能内存相关主题。目前公开摘要未披露费率、成分股或上市交易所等更多细节。此举显示资产管理公司正在扩展 AI 细分领域的主题投资产品。
items.summary_en: Global X Launches Global X Artificial Intelligence Memory Index ETF (DRAM), and Six Other ETFs TradingView
items.why_zh: AI 内存成为新的主题投资赛道，反映资本市场对 AI 硬件细分环节的关注。
items.why_en: AI memory is emerging as a new thematic investment niche, reflecting capital market interest in specific AI hardware segments.

items.title_zh: Marist University 与 IBM 以 IBM z17 启动创新孵化器，拓展 50 年合作以推进 AI 研究与培养学生职业能力
items.title_en: Marist University and IBM Launch Innovation Incubator with IBM z17, Expanding 50-Year Partnership to Advance AI Research and Student Career Readiness
items.summary_zh: 根据 IBM 新闻室消息，Marist University 与 IBM 共同启动了一个创新孵化器，采用 IBM z17 大型机。此举扩展了双方长达 50 年的合作伙伴关系，目标是推进人工智能研究并提升学生的职业准备度。该孵化器将把 IBM 的企业级计算平台引入校园，为学生提供与 AI 相关的实践和研究机会。但公开摘要未透露孵化器的具体项目、时间表或参与方式。
items.summary_en: Marist University and IBM Launch Innovation Incubator with IBM z17, Expanding 50-Year Partnership to Advance AI Research and Student Career Readiness newsroom.ibm.com
items.why_zh: 高校与企业合作将大型机平台用于 AI 研究与人才培养，有助于缩小学术研究与产业需求之间的技能差距。
items.why_en: The university-industry collaboration using mainframe platforms for AI research and talent development can help bridge the skills gap between academia and industry needs.
